introHtml: Sherpa sweaters and cardigans offer the warmth of fleece with a textured, cozy look that stands out in cold-weather branding campaigns. Unlike plain knitwear, the plush sherpa lining adds a premium feel that employees and customers will actually want to wear. Ideal for winter giveaways, corporate retreats, or outdoor events, these garments can be embroidered or screen-printed with your logo for lasting visibility.
